title: MathWars problem
description: One problem, stored as data/problems/<id>.json. Text fields are Markdown with $…$ and $$…$$ LaTeX; the site currently renders blank-line-separated paragraphs and passes inline HTML through.

id.description: Kebab-case, unique, stable forever: it is the URL (#p-<id>), the file name and the hash salt.

subtopics.description: Technique and configuration slugs. Once data/taxonomy.json (task 03) exists, validate.mjs checks them against it.

status.description: draft: not shown in lists. beta: shown, kyu not yet confirmed. ranked: official. retired: hidden from lists, but its page still resolves.

figure.description: An SVG beside the statement (task 10). The service worker caches SVGs forever, so a changed figure needs a new file name.

answer_format.description: What the answer looks like. The checker accepts any number, decimal or fraction; this tells the UI and the pipeline what to expect.

answer_hash.description: fnv(id + "|" + canon(answer)) from js/lib/answers.js. Make it with scripts/hash-answer.mjs.

rubric.description: Proof problems only. The marks total 7 (checked by validate.mjs).

author.description: Who wrote this version: the wording, hints and solution.

source.description: Classical only: where the problem comes from, e.g. "IMO 1988 P6".

book.description: Classical only: e.g. "Beyond the Incenter, Problem 50" (task 21).

pipeline_run.description: Generated problems only: the pipeline run that produced it.

verification.description: The task 05 verification report ID. Required unless status is draft. The 21 seed problems carry "seed-unverified" until task 05 or 11 runs them through the gate.

stats.description: Real counts only; all zeros until there is data.
